title: Get a permit to film on council land
what: Get the council's permit before filming or making a recording for commercial gain on council property.

laws.title: City of Kalamunda Local Government Property Local Law 2026

sources.title: City of Kalamunda Local Government Property Local Law 2026
sources.locator: cl 3.1(1)(s), as made, Gazette No. 126, 2 Oct 2026
sources.quote: On any local government property a person must not without a permit—

sources.title: City of Kalamunda Local Government Property Local Law 2026
sources.locator: cl 3.1(1)(s), as made, Gazette No. 126, 2 Oct 2026
sources.quote: record or carry on an activity for film, video or television production for a commercial purpose, other than for news reporting or current affairs

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found.

assessment.summary: Filming on council land needs the council's permit.
